messages:
Elaine: Customer (FinCorp) asked whether we can offer a sub-1h upgrade path for private deployments that includes an HSM key rotation and an in-region routing handoff. Need options they can pick in the console.
Marco: Two sensible choices: 
- Redwood-managed rapid cutover (45-60m): we run the operator swap + IP handoff.
- Tenant-by-tenant staged migration: longer total time, near-zero per-tenant downtime.
Jin: HSM rotation is the twist. Auditors often require a signed rotation export and manual approver which adds hours.
Priya: We can require a staging dry-run for HSM customers and mandate an audit artifact before production windows. That makes the <1h promise realistic for the cutover itself.
Marco: For Redwood-managed cutover we should require a paid support addon + signed runbook. NetOps will only touch customer BGP with those guardrails.
NetOps: Confirmed. We need a validated runbook, preflight proof (AS-path, ACL checks), and an automatic rollback trigger to accept responsibility.
Elaine: UX idea: surface a "Managed cutover" checkbox on the upgrade page with tooltip (SLA + price) and block it unless preflight passes.
Jin: SRE: add automatic rollback thresholds (error-rate spike OR 99p latency >X). Expose an emergency revert API button during the window.
Priya: Legal: will draft consent language for managed routing. Also add HSM acceptance criteria: dry-run, exportable artifact, named approver.
OpsBot: Preflight available -> /preflight <customer-id>. Suggested gates: ip-reserved, dns-resolves, kms-prestaged, operator-health, model-pin locked, kv-cache warm >= 90%.
Elaine: Actions: Marco + Product: console copy & pricing; Jin + Eng: revert API & thresholds; NetOps: runbook + verification script; Priya: legal clause + HSM checklist; OpsBot: wire preflight gating. Sync Wed 9am PT.
Marco: +1
Priya: +1
Jin: :thumbsup:
